paite: Aw, TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu gen unla, amin lou un; michih lak ah athilhihte theisak un.
heading: Pathian Leh Amite

paite: Amah pahtawi in la sa unla, amah phat in la sa un; athillamdang hih tengteng thu in houlim un.
Amin siangthou suang un; TOUPA zongte lungtang nuamsa hen.
TOUPA leh ahatna zong unla; amel zong gige un.
Anasep zohsa lamdangte, athillamdangte leh akam a vaihawmnate theigige un;
Asikha Abraham suante aw, atelte Jakob tate aw.
Amah TOUPA i Pathian ahi a; avaihawmte leitung ah a-om hi.
Athukhun tangtawn in atheigige hi, suan sangkhat tan a athu na piak ngei;
Abraham kiang a athukhun leh, Isak kiang a akichiamna ngei;
Huai mah dan thuseh a ding in Jakob kiang ah ahihkip a, Israel kiang a tangtawn thukhun ding in.
Kanaan gam na kiang ah ka hon pe dia, na goutan tuam ding in chi in.
Mi tawmchik phet ahih lai un; ahi, tawmchik phet, huai gam ah mikhual ahi ngal ua;
Nam tuamtuam kiang ah apai ua, gam tuamtuam a kipan in mi tuamtuamte kiang ah,
Kuamah nuaisiah aphal kei a, ahi, amau ziak in kumpipate ataihilh a,
Ka thaunilhte khoih kei unla, ka zawlneite hih na kei un, chi in.
Huai gam a tung ding in kial asam a; nek ding himhim a-omsakta kei hi.
Ama uah mi asawl a; sikha ding in Joseph zuak in a-om a,
akhete kol in ahih na ua; sik khainiang bun in a-om hi.
Athu atun masiah, TOUPA thu in amah aze-et gige hi.
Kumpipa'n mi sawl in, akhahkhia a, mite vaihawmpa ngei in asuaktasak hi.
A-insung a heutu ding leh, asum tengteng tung a vaihawm ding in abawl a,
Amiliante a-utut a hen ding leh; a-upate hihpil ding in.
Israel leng Aigupta gam ah ahoh a; Ham gam ah Jakob a-om tadih hi.
Amite nakpitak in apungsak a, amau doute sang in ahihhat zawta hi.
Amite ho ding in alungtang uh alehngatsak a, asikhate tung a lepchiahtak a hih ding in.
Asikha Mosi asawl a, amitel Aaron toh.
Amau achiamtehnate alak uah a-ensak ua, Ham gam ah thillamdangte a- ensak uhi.
Ama'n mial asawl a, ahihmialta a; huchi in athute anialta kei uhi.
Atuite uh sisan asuaksak a, a ngasate uh ahihlumta hi.
Agam uh ukeng in adimta a, kumpipa dantan sung nangawn ah.
Ama'n thu agen a, thou tampi hong pai ua, hik leng agamsung pumpi uah ahong om uhi.
Akiang uah vuah sik in gial apia a, agam uah meikuang zualzual apeta hi.
Agrep guite leh atheipi kungte uh asisak a; agam ua singte akitansakta hi.
Ama'n thu agen a, khaupete ahong pai ua, lungte toh, sim zoh vual louh in.
Huaite'n agam ua haichiteng anegai ua, aleigahte uh leng agai uhi.
Agam ua ta masa om tengteng athat a, ahatna tengteng ua gah masapente uh.
Huchi in dangka leh dangka- eng toh apikheta a; amah namte lak ah mihat lou khat leng a-om kei hi.
Apawt lai un Aiguptate akipak ua, amau alau tak ziak un.
Ama'n aliah ding in meipi akaisak a, zan a tanvak ding in meikuang leng apia hi.
Angen ua, huchi in vamim apia a, van an in amau ataisakta hi.
Suangpi ahong a, huchi in tui ahong pawt zuazua a, mun keute ah lui bang in aluangta hi.
Athu siangthou atheigige a, asikha Abraham toh.
Huchi in amite nuamsatak in apikheta a, amitelte lasa kawmkawm in.
Namte' gamte akiang uah apia a; amau michih sepkhiaksa aluahta uhi.
Adan thusehte azuihtheihna ding un, adante akephoihna ding in, TOUPA phat un.
